answer.rationale: The retained recording-specific official-opening review identifies Fort Worth City Council and the 2008 Gas Drilling Task Force as participants in a Joint Environmental Workshop. The player title corroborates the Council–Task Force workshop identification. Assign the whole recording to the City Council feed and the Gas Drilling Task Force feed, whose description explicitly includes proven joint workshops with Council, and to the broader Fort Worth feed covering Council recordings. The evidence does not identify this as the separately configured City Council Worksession series; 'Environmental' likewise does not establish participation by the Property Management and Environmental Services Committee. The opening's October 14 workshop date is retained as evidence without altering the supplied recording date or official title.
